|note_res_ECLPO=Osasuna were initially disqualified from the [[2023–24 UEFA Europa Conference League]] due to historic match-fixing.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/osasuna-barred-uefa-conference-league-over-historic-match-fixing-scandal-club-2023-07-04/ |title=Osasuna barred from UEFA Conference League over historic match-fixing scandal |publisher=Reuters |date=4 July 2023 |access-date=5 July 2023}}</ref> However, the club became later eligible to participate after an evidence of innocence had been provided.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.uefa.com/insideuefa/news/0283-1893b9339442-562cf8597287-1000--uefa-statement-on-ca-osasuna/ |title=UEFA statement on CA Osasuna |publisher=UEFA |date=25 July 2023 }}</ref>
